mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM co_aply_info WHERE PRCS_STTS_CD = 'WAIT') AS PENDING_COMPANY_CNT ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_info WHERE DATE(REG_DT) = CURDATE()) AS TODAY_USER_CNT ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM co_info WHERE USE_YN = 'Y') AS ACTIVE_COMPANY_CNT ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_log_info WHERE LOG_LEVEL_CD IN ('ERROR', 'WARN') AND DATE(REG_DT) = CURDATE()) AS TODAY_ERROR_CNT
SELECT APLY_SN ,CO_NM ,BRNO ,APLCNT_NM ,REG_DT ,PRCS_STTS_CD FROM co_aply_info WHERE PRCS_STTS_CD = 'WAIT' ORDER BY REG_DT ASC LIMIT 8
SELECT SYS_LOG_SN ,LOG_SE_CD ,LOG_LEVEL_CD ,LOG_TITLE ,USER_ID ,REG_DT FROM sys_log_info WHERE LOG_LEVEL_CD IN ('ERROR', 'WARN') ORDER BY REG_DT DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT H.ADMIN_PRCS_SN ,H.ADMIN_ID ,COALESCE(U.USER_NM, H.ADMIN_ID) AS ADMIN_NM ,H.TARGET_SE_CD ,H.TARGET_ID ,H.ACTION_CN ,H.REG_DT FROM admin_prcs_hstry H LEFT JOIN user_info U ON U.USER_ID = H.ADMIN_ID ORDER BY H.REG_DT DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT A.APLY_SN ,A.CO_NM ,A.BRNO ,A.APLCNT_NM ,A.RPRSV_NM ,A.PIC_TELNO ,A.PIC_EML_ADDR ,A.PRCS_STTS_CD ,A.RJCT_RSN ,A.REG_DT ,A.PRCS_DT ,A.PRCS_USER_ID ,C.CO_ID FROM co_aply_info A LEFT JOIN co_info C ON C.APLY_SN = A.APLY_SN WHERE 1 = 1
AND A.PRCS_STTS_CD = #{prcsSttsCd}
AND ( A.CO_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%') OR A.BRNO LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%') OR A.APLCNT_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%') OR A.PIC_EML_ADDR LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%') )
ORDER BY CASE A.PRCS_STTS_CD WHEN 'WAIT' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, A.REG_DT DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT A.APLY_SN ,A.CO_NM ,A.BRNO ,A.APLCNT_NM ,A.RPRSV_NM ,A.PIC_TELNO ,A.PIC_EML_ADDR ,A.ORGNL_FILE_NM ,A.ENCPT_FILE_NM ,A.FILE_PATH_NM ,A.PRCS_STTS_CD ,A.RJCT_RSN ,A.REG_DT ,A.PRCS_DT ,A.PRCS_USER_ID ,C.CO_ID FROM co_aply_info A LEFT JOIN co_info C ON C.APLY_SN = A.APLY_SN WHERE A.APLY_SN = #{aplySn}
SELECT APLY_SN ,CO_NM ,BRNO ,APLCNT_NM ,RPRSV_NM ,PIC_TELNO ,PIC_EML_ADDR ,PRCS_STTS_CD FROM co_aply_info WHERE APLY_SN = #{aplySn} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM co_info WHERE APLY_SN = #{APLY_SN} OR (BRNO IS NOT NULL AND BRNO = #{BRNO})

SELECT C.CO_ID ,C.CO_CD ,C.CO_NM ,C.BRNO ,C.RPRSV_NM ,C.PIC_NM ,C.PIC_TELNO ,C.PIC_EML_ADDR ,C.USE_YN ,C.REG_DT ,COUNT(U.USER_ID) AS USER_CNT ,SUM(CASE WHEN U.USE_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ACTIVE_USER_CNT FROM co_info C LEFT JOIN user_info U ON U.CO_ID = C.CO_ID WHERE 1 = 1
AND C.USE_YN = #{useYn}
AND ( C.CO_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%') OR C.CO_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%') OR C.BRNO LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%') )
GROUP BY C.CO_ID, C.CO_CD, C.CO_NM, C.BRNO, C.RPRSV_NM ,C.PIC_NM, C.PIC_TELNO, C.PIC_EML_ADDR, C.USE_YN, C.REG_DT ORDER BY C.REG_DT DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT U.USER_ID ,U.USER_NM ,U.CO_ID ,C.CO_NM ,D.DEPT_NM ,U.JBPS_NM ,U.AUTHRT_ID ,A.AUTHRT_NM ,U.USER_TELNO ,U.USE_YN ,U.REG_DT FROM user_info U LEFT JOIN co_info C ON C.CO_ID = U.CO_ID LEFT JOIN dept_info D ON D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN authrt_info A ON A.AUTHRT_ID = U.AUTHRT_ID WHERE 1 = 1
AND U.USE_YN = #{useYn}
AND ( U.USER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%') OR U.USER_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%') OR C.CO_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%') OR D.DEPT_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%') )
ORDER BY U.REG_DT DESC LIMIT 300

SELECT H.ADMIN_PRCS_SN ,H.ADMIN_ID ,COALESCE(U.USER_NM, H.ADMIN_ID) AS ADMIN_NM ,H.ACTION_SE_CD ,H.TARGET_SE_CD ,H.TARGET_ID ,H.ACTION_CN ,H.REG_DT FROM admin_prcs_hstry H LEFT JOIN user_info U ON U.USER_ID = H.ADMIN_ID WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( H.ADMIN_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%') OR U.USER_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%') OR H.TARGET_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%') OR H.ACTION_CN LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%') )
ORDER BY H.REG_DT DESC LIMIT 500
SELECT CD_GROUP_ID ,CD_GROUP_NM ,USE_YN ,SORT_SEQ FROM cmn_cd_group ORDER BY SORT_SEQ, CD_GROUP_ID
SELECT CD_GROUP_ID ,CD ,CD_NM ,CD_EXPLN ,SORT_SEQ ,DFLT_YN ,USE_YN FROM cmn_cd WHERE CD_GROUP_ID = #{cdGroupId} ORDER BY SORT_SEQ, CD
SELECT POLICY_ID ,POLICY_NM ,POLICY_VALUE ,POLICY_EXPLN ,MDFR_ID ,MDFCN_DT FROM oper_policy ORDER BY SORT_SEQ, POLICY_ID
